Agent Name: Literature_Expert  
Step Number: 7  
Reason for Mistake: The agent prematurely assumed that simply downloading the Project MUSE page would provide the book’s chapter text, but the page retrieved was just the landing page HTML, not Chapter 2 itself. This led to an unsupported conclusion that the content had been “successfully retrieved” and stalled the solution without actually identifying the author influencing the neurologist’s belief in “endopsychic myths.”
